svg.text: NodeMCU ESP-12E plugged into a GPIO 1-into-2 breakout board · 5 × 12×12 mm tact switches
Coloured wire: pin S → one leg of the switch
Black wire: the diagonally opposite leg of every switch, chained together → any G header
V is not used · no resistors needed (internal pull-ups)
Header order can differ — follow the G / V / S printed on your board
